newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 16.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 16.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Budapest plans to increase the number of policemen and to renovate the buildings in the inner city.
-- Slovakia still lacks the political will to reconstruct the bridge over the Danube at Parkany, which would be a road link between the country and Hungary.
-- This year will be the first when the programme of Budapest's annual religious festival will be coloured by a carnival procession.
-- The parliament continues to discuss the pension reform drafts.
